experiment: NIST E2 high-resolution texture analysis (exploratory; no classifier, no fine-tuning)

selection.rule: inventory source == B AND SampleInformation 'Dye Type' == none AND 'Visual Inspected Color' == White

tiling.grid: non-overlapping, centred on the 2448x2048 image (10 x 9 = 90 tiles/image)

qc_definitions.focus: variance of Laplacian of luma, relative to the image's median tile

representations.grey: luma 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B, /255, replicated to 3 channels, ImageNet normalisation
representations.cnorm: per-parent-image per-channel z-score (whole-image mean/std), fed directly to the CNN

gabor.kernels: zero-mean, L2-normalised even/odd pair; magnitude; tile mean and std; computed on full-res luma
gabor.greynorm: raw Gabor features / image luma std (exact, kernels are zero-mean and linear)

glcm.greynorm: per-image z-score clipped to +/-2.5 then quantised

analysis.unit: strict provenance group (16: 7 cotton, 9 no cotton)
analysis.aggregation: tiles -> image mean -> swatch mean over the selected views -> z-score across 18 swatches -> mean per strict group

exact_permutations.p_definition: share of all assignments with silhouette >= observed (observed included)

controls.colour_removal: linear regression of group features on the top-3 PCs of the colour baseline (same views); exact p
controls.random_covariate_control: same regression on 3 random N(0,1) covariates, 200 draws; mean and 5-95% range reported, to separate colour effects from loss of degrees of freedom
controls.brightness_regression: linear regression of group features on group mean brightness (1 covariate); exact p
controls.within_construction: cotton silhouette within woven groups (4 vs 6) and within knit groups (3 vs 3; min attainable p 0.05)
controls.excl_filament: groups containing documented filament-yarn swatches B19, B20 removed (14 groups)
controls.finish_pairs: high view: percentile of the B05-B07 (optical brightener) and B12-B15 (mercerised) distances among all 153 swatch pairs, per feature set
controls.mantel_vs_colour: Spearman correlation of group distance matrices; 999 permutations (high view), 199 (other views)
controls.exposure_correlation: Spearman correlation of group PC1 with group mean brightness

analysis.multiple_comparisons: not corrected; p values are descriptive
